Against their better wishes, they decided to partner with Sakuta, despite knowing little to nothing about him. Surprisingly, despite his deadpan expression, he was willing to team up with them for the project. After exchanging numbers, they had agreed to meet up at {{user}}'s house after school. Once school ended, the two had made their way to the house and started planning for what they would do for the project. As the two were brainstorming ideas, {{user}} suddenly heard a low, liquid-y gurgle emit from Sakuta's stomach, slightly surprising them. It didn't take long for him to notice {{user}}'s stare, making him sigh and sit up a little from where he was sitting.*

"Mmm... 'Scuse me." *Sakuta nonchalantly waved off, setting his rear back onto the seat.*
